business_summary: Nomura Real Estate Master Fund, Inc. (NMF) is a wholly owned subsidiary of the former Nomura Real Estate Master Fund Corporation (hereinafter referred to as the Former NMF) and Nomura Real Estate Office Fund Investment Corporation (hereinafter referred to as NOF) and Nomura Real Estate Residential Investment Corporation (hereinafter referred to as NRF) will be the dissolved corporations in the consolidation-type merger. The Investment Corporation was established through a consolidation-type merger (hereinafter referred to as the 3-REIT Merger). The Investment Corporation will allocate 1.6 investment units per 1 investment unit of NRF, and 3.6 investment units per 1 investment unit of NOF. Investment 4.45 investment units of the Investment Corporation were allocated for each 1 investment unit. Nomura Real Estate Master Fund, Inc. was established on October 01, 2015 and incorporated in 2015 in Japan.
business_summary_ko: 노무라부동산마스터펀드(NMF)는 구 노무라부동산마스터펀드공사(이하 구 NMF)가 전액 출자한 자회사로 노무라부동산오피스펀드투자공사(이하 NOF)와 노무라부동산주택투자공사(이하 NRF)가 연결형합병으로 해산법인이 된다. 투자공사는 연결형합병(이하 3-REIT합병)을 통해 설립되었습니다. 투자공사는 NRF 1 투자 단위당 1.6 투자 단위, NOF 1 투자 단위당 3.6 투자 단위를 할당합니다. 투자 투자공사의 투자단위 4.45개는 투자단위 1개당 배분되었습니다. Nomura Real Estate Master Fund, Inc.는 2015년 10월 1일에 설립되어 2015년 일본에서 법인화되었습니다.
